newsitem.title: UK: European Colour gains after press comment.
newsitem.headline: European Colour gains after press comment.

text.p: Shares in European Colour Plc rose sharply on Monday, after positive comment on the stock in the Financial Mail on Sunday, dealers said.
The stock was up 7p or 11.7 percent at 67p by 1116 GMT in active trade of 842,591 shares -- extending a rebound from a three-year low of 48p set on April 2.
The Mail highlighted recent purchases of shares by directors of the company and said analysts expect forthcoming year-emd results to show a 30 percent jump in pre-tax profit to 3.8 million stg.
It said the company's specialisation in pigments used in packaging protected it from the gloom currently enveloping much of the chemical sector.
